name: aoci-code
description: A persistent, Git-versioned map of your whole codebase and database schema that coding agents read before they touch anything. Local-first MCP server + CLI in Go: a governed repository index of code knowledge that gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and opencode long-term context, memory, and code intelligence.

analysis.summary_en: A persistent, Git-versioned map of your entire codebase — written by your coding agent, governed by a local MCP server.
highlights: Fault-injection scenarios — 65 scenarios covering cursor tampering,
Protocol conformance — 46 read-only checks of the MCP wire surface;
generating a deterministic plan, target set, and source SHA-256 values;
A — API: which interfaces, commands, formats, or observable contracts it exposes.
analysis.summary_zh_native: AOCI-CODE 是一种为 AI Agent 建立软件项目全局认知的索引方法，可提供持久化、可治理的代码仓库认知地图。
highlights_zh: 一个受支持的 MCP 宿主，例如 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 或 OpenCode；
协议一致性 —— 46 项只读检查，覆盖 MCP 线协议表面；
AI Agent 必须沿 next_cursor 自动读取到最后一个 Chunk；
升级轴 —— 每个已发布版本 72 项检查，覆盖九种仓库形状：每个公开发布版本
